components.name: Text field
components.description: Browser approximation of a native labeled text field.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:6px;font:14px 'Segoe UI',sans-serif;color:CanvasText}.ds-field input{font:inherit;min-height:36px;padding:7px 10px;background:Canvas;color:CanvasText;border:1px solid ActiveBorder}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid Highlight}.ds-field input:disabled{opacity:.5}

components.name: Format selector
components.description: Browser approximation; the WPF template preserves native ComboBox keyboard interaction.
components.css: .ds-select{display:grid;gap:6px;font:14px 'Segoe UI',sans-serif;color:CanvasText}.ds-select select{font:inherit;min-height:36px;padding:7px 10px;background:Canvas;color:CanvasText;border:1px solid ActiveBorder;border-radius:4px}.ds-select select:hover{border-color:Highlight}.ds-select select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid Highlight}.ds-select select:disabled{opacity:.5}

narrative.overview: The user requested a familiar Windows appearance across every window. The interface uses native WPF controls, restrained separators, readable grouping, and clear completion actions. Desktop operation matters more than decorative identity.
keyCharacteristics: System-colored surfaces and selection, rather than a fixed dark palette.
Native window management, keyboard navigation, and accessible field labels.
Consistent action placement and compact floating overlays.

rules.name: The System Pair Rule
rules.body: Pair Window with WindowText and Highlight with HighlightText. Do not restore fixed light text over native light dropdowns.

dos: Do reuse the application styles and system color pairs.
Do preserve named controls, event handlers, keyboard operation, and existing recording/export safeguards.
Do check constrained window sizes and long file/device names.
donts: Don't introduce a fixed dark foreground palette into native light controls.
Don't add decorative icons or imagery to task-focused windows.
